News

Chase Atlantic Share Emotional New Track ‘wherever you are’

by Jack Rogers | November 24, 2026
Listen to audio version of this article
Sponsored by
0:00 / 0:51
Instaread

Chase Atlantic have returned with their first new music in just over a year, following the deluxe edition of their album ‘LOST IN HEAVEN’ last October.


The track is called ‘wherever you are’, and is a woozy pop-rock banger brimming with the band’s signature blend emotion and intensity. Littered with reflection and a feeling of realising you have to face off against the consequences of your actions, especially when it comes to those actions involving the ones that you love, it is a suitably understated offering.

powered by

It’s the band’s first release as part of the Atlantic Records family, and sets up 2027 to be another landmark year for the trio.
